title: Read an image's header and metadata — pix_info
text: x File paths (one row ), raw vector holding one file's bytes, connection, read whole. format "auto" reads format file's signature, never extension. named format ("png", "jpeg", "webp", "qoi") disagrees signature error. limits Limits checked anything allocated; see pix_limits().

title: Read an image's header and metadata — pix_info
text: data frame one row per image columns: format: "png", "jpeg", "webp" "qoi". width, height: pixels, stored (EXIF rotation). bits: stored sample depth: 1, 2, 4, 8 16 PNG; precision JPEG (8, 12 zupix decode); 8 otherwise. colour_type: "grey", "grey_alpha", "rgb", "rgba", "palette", "ycbcr", "cmyk" "ycck", stored. JPEG lossy WebP store YCbCr; CMYK YCCK JPEG decode RGB. alpha: whether image transparency, including PNG tRNS. interlaced: Adam7 PNG progressive JPEG. animated: APNG animated WebP; pix_read() decodes first frame. density_x, density_y, density_unit: PNG pHYs (unit 1: pixels per metre) JPEG JFIF header (1: per inch, 2: per centimetre); unit 0 gives aspect ratio. NA absent. orientation: EXIF orientation, 1 8, NA. See pix_orient(). gamma, srgb: PNG gAMA (stored value 100,000) sRGB rendering intent, NA. chrm: list column, PNG cHRM's eight chromaticities (white, red, green, blue; x y), NULL. cicp: list column, PNG cICP's four integers (colour primaries, transfer function, matrix coefficients, full-range flag), NULL. icc, exif: whether ICC profile EXIF data present; see pix_icc() pix_exif(). qoi_linear: QOI, whether header declares linear channels rather sRGB; NA formats.

text: x file path, raw vector holding file's bytes, connection, read whole (max_bytes limits). shape result: "native": nativeRaster, 8-bit RGBA, png::readPNG(native = TRUE) returns. 16-bit samples rounded 8 bits. "double": height x width x channels array values [0, 1], matrix one channel, png::readPNG() returns. 16-bit precision kept. "integer": shape holding sample values, 0..255 0..65535, attribute bits (8L 16L). bits NULL keeps file's depth (1-, 2- 4-bit PNGs become 8); 8L 16L forces . = "native", always 8-bit, must NULL 8L. channels NULL keeps file's channels: 1 grey, 2 grey alpha, 3 RGB, 4 RGBA; palette becomes 3, 4 transparency. larger number adds channels (grey RGB, opaque alpha); smaller one error, removing colour alpha colour decision. = "native", always RGBA, must NULL 4L. orient TRUE applies image's EXIF orientation (see pix_orient()); FALSE, default, returns pixels stored. format "auto" reads format file's signature, never extension. named format ("png", "jpeg", "webp", "qoi") disagrees signature error. limits Limits checked anything allocated; see pix_limits().

title: zupix 0.1.0
text: Initial CRAN submission. pix_read() decodes PNG (every colour type depth, palettes, tRNS, Adam7), JPEG (baseline progressive; grey, YCbCr, CMYK YCCK RGB), WebP (lossy, lossy alpha, lossless) QOI nativeRaster, double array [0, 1] integer array bits attribute, path, raw vector connection. bits channels force depth add channels. pix_format() names image’s format signature. Animated PNG WebP decode first frame, flagged animated attribute. pix_info() reports format, size, depth, colour type, alpha, interlacing, animation, density, EXIF orientation, PNG colour chunks (gAMA, cHRM, sRGB, cICP) whether ICC EXIF data present, without decoding pixels, number files. pix_icc() pix_exif() return raw ICC profile EXIF block. pix_write(), pix_write_png(), pix_write_jpeg(), pix_write_webp() pix_write_qoi() encode shapes pix_read() returns, file raw vector. PNG zupix’s writer zlib, 8 16 bits 1 4 channels; JPEG uses libjpeg-turbo (quality, subsampling, progressive); WebP uses libwebp (lossy lossless); QOI uses reference encoder. PNG, JPEG WebP embed optional ICC profile EXIF block. packages’ C code can sniff, probe, decode, read metadata encode registered table: Imports LinkingTo: zupix, #include <zupix-r.h> call zupix_api(). table never calls R raises R error. See inst/include/zupix.h. pix_orient() applies EXIF orientation losslessly; pix_read(orient = TRUE) reading. Pixels come back stored default. pix_limits() bounds image may make zupix allocate: every size image declares checked anything allocated, breach zupix_limit_error. Every error classed condition inheriting zupix_error (see ?zupix-conditions). zupix_info() reports bundled Wuffs, libjpeg-turbo, libwebp qoi.h versions, upstream commits local patches, linked zlib version, whether Wuffs’s SIMD code compiled.
